applications.equipment: Explosion-Proof Local Control Panel (LCP) for Soot Blower
features: Real-time operating status indication for valves and soot blowers.
HMI/Indicator display of operating modes (Remote Auto/Local Auto/Local Manual), run status, and system alarms (Overload/Timeout).
Power isolation control: 380V AC main power and 24V DC control power switching.
Load control: Mode switching, sequence execution (Pause/Resume/E-Stop/Reset), and discrete actuator switching.
technicalContributions: Liaised with the client to define project scope. Integrated the new explosion-proof LCP with the existing legacy S7-300 master PLC without altering core logic.
Confirmed I/O requirements and designed electrical schematics, ensuring strict alignment with ATEX standards, enclosure sizing, and mounting specifications.
Coordinated with external panel builders for component selection, enclosure material, cutout design, and cable entry routing.
Managed on-site installation, cabling, and loop checking.
Conducted load testing, Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and operator training.

applications.equipment: Mining Explosion-Proof VFD (3-Phase 660V) with Heat Pipe Forced Air Cooling Enclosure
technicalContributions: Conducted complex on-site troubleshooting for damaged output inverter IGBT modules.

Performed root cause analysis: Analyzed fault history (frequent overload/overvoltage) and complex underground airflow dynamics. Identified that the 'Flying Start' parameter was disabled, causing motor regeneration and DC bus overvoltage during startup against opposing wind currents.
Sourced and verified spare parts including 3 sets of IGBT modules, filter capacitors, and current-limiting resistors for immediate intervention.
Executed on-site hardware repairs, component replacement, enclosure reassembly, and static electrical checks.
Powered on and recommissioned the drive under load, optimized VFD parameters (enabled Flying Start), and eliminated the recurring fault.
